data.narrative:
Tobe Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Colby DeWeese and Caleb Lareau, having raised $4.6M to date. The comparable universe spans nine private firms in Climate & Energy, including later-stage peers such as Helion, Redwood Materials, and Electric Hydrogen, alongside one public comparable (LNZA). However, no same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with sufficient similarity exist to support multiples-based valuation.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised as a valuation proxy ($5M), the analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for progression from Seed to the next funding round. This yields an implied valuation of $12M. The peer-median method was excluded due to insufficient narrow peer data—while nine Climate & Energy companies exist in the broader comp set, none meet the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier classification, making a sector-wide median unreliable.

The triangulated analysis, derived from a single applicable method, supports a median valuation of $12M with a range of $10M to $13M. The low end reflects downside assumptions on step-up multiples; the high end assumes acceleration. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer benchmarks, early-stage execution risk, and the impact of commodity-price and regulatory volatility on sector comparables. This range should be revisited once additional stage-appropriate peers or financial metrics become available.
